source: 611 True Name
target: 611 Verum Nomen

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: As Lumian’s body was ripped apart by the explosion, he drew upon an Ascetic’s tolerance for pain and a Pyromaniac’s resistance to burning, activating the black mark on his right shoulder once again.
target: Cum corpus Lumiani a explosione laceratum esset, patientiam doloris ascetici atque ardoris pyromaniaci adhibuit, nigrum signum in dextro umero iterum activans.

source: Alongside Father Montserrat, whose neck had been pierced by the Symphony of Hatred, he vanished into the swirling flames, reappearing at the edge of the dark wilderness.
target: Una cum Patre Montserrat, cuius collum a Symphonia Odii perforatus erat, in gyrantia ignis evanuit, et ad limen obscurae solitudinis repraesentatus reintroduxit se.

source: His linen shirt, black vest, and dark pants lay in tatters.
target: Tunica linerea, lorica nigra, et bracae obscurae in laceratis pannis iacebant.

source: The exposed parts were mangled and charred, revealing white bones in some places.
target: Partes patefactae laniatae atque ustulatae erant, quarum quibusdam locis ossa alba patefaciebant.

source: Father Montserrat, close to death, had the filthy, translucent white membrane on his body torn and burned away by the explosion.
target: Pater Montserrat, prope mortem imminentem, membranam sordidam atque translucide albam in corpore suo ab explosione laceratam atque comburitam habebat.

source: The mutated naked body with various organs below was dented and charred, with flesh and blood constantly peeling off.
target: Corpus nudum mutatum, cum variis organis subiectis, depressum atque ustulatum erat, dum caro ac sanguis continue excidiebantur.

source: Snap.
target: Crepitus.

source: As the first piece of flesh landed on the edge of the weed-covered darkness, it suddenly seeped in, as if absorbed by the soil.
target: Cum prima pars carnis in limine obscuritatis herbarum opertae cecidisset, subito infusa est, quasi a terra absorpta.

source: Witnessing this, Lumian’s heart stirred.
target: Hoc videns, cor Lumiani excitatum est.

source: He grabbed Father Montserrat’s body and activated teleportation once again.
target: Corpus Patris Montserrat apprehendit et teleportationem iterum activavit.

source: They left the dark wilderness and materialized on the deck bathed in crimson moonlight.
target: Ex obscura solitudine discesserunt et in tabulato, in luce lunari rubro induta, apparuerunt.

source: Simultaneously, the illusory oak tree in the depths of the cargo hold shed its bark, revealing moist, slippery flesh.
target: Simul, quercus illusorius in profundis cellae vecturae corticem abnuit, ostendens carnem humidam atque lubricam.

source: The blood-filled flesh began to squirm, but only a palm-sized figure emerged.
target: Caro sanguine plena contorquebatur, sed sola figura parva, ad palmarum dimensiones similis, orta est.

source: The figure, nearly the same size as the blob of flesh that had dropped from Father Montserrat and been absorbed by the wilderness, had clear eyes and a youthful appearance, resembling Father Montserrat, who had shrunk countless times.
target: Figura, paene eandem magnitudinem quam massa carnis a Patre Montserrat lapsa et in solitudine absorpta habens, oculos claros atque speciem iuvenilem exhibebat, similis Patre Montserrat, qui innumeris contractionibus passa erat.

source: Father Montserrat’s eyes were glazed, and his expression was rigid, showing no signs of intelligence.
target: Oculi Patris Montserrat vitrei erant, et vultus eius rigidus, nullas intelligentiae notas ostendens.

source: The silver-white Pride Armor rushed over and swung the re-condensed light hammer down, flattening the pixie-like Father Montserrat and turning him into a bloody pulp.
target: Armatura superbiae argenteo-alba celeriter accessit et malleum lucis recondensum deiecxit, Patrem Montserrat pixia similem comprimens atque eum in pulpem sanguinolentum convertere fecit.

source: Dawn lit up, melting the meat paste quickly.
target: Aurora lucebat, celeriter pastam carnis liquescens.

source: The illusory colossal oak tree instantly became more transparent, and the black wilderness with weeds rapidly disintegrated.
target: Quercus ingens illusoria statim magis perspicua facta est, et solitudo nigra cum herbis celeriter dissoluta est.

source: In the blink of an eye, the abnormal scene vanished.
target: In ictu oculi, scena anomala evanuit.

source: The cargo hold returned to its original state, but many wooden boxes had shattered, and the steel walls and floor bore obvious depressions and deep marks.
target: Cella oneraria ad statum originalem rediit, sed multa arcae ligneae confractae erant, et parietes ac solum ferreum evidentes incisiones atque depressiones gerebant.

source: Elsewhere, Lumian drew the Symphony of Hatred’s black bone flute and observed as Father Montserrat’s blood dripped onto the steel deck without soaking in.
target: Alibi, Lumian flautam ex ossibus nigris, cuius erat Symphonia Odii, extraxit et aspexit, dum sanguis Patris Montserrat in tabulato ferreo stillabat sine imbibitione.

source: Just as he breathed a sigh of relief, he heard Father Montserrat, who had fallen to the ground and entered a dying state, weakly but persistently shout, “To banish the… Child of God… you must grasp… His true name!”
target: Cum levamen exhalationis edidisset, audivit Patrem Montserrat, qui in terram ceciderat atque in statum moriendum redactus esset, debiliter sed pertinaciter clamantem: “Ut exspellas… Puer Dei… necesse est ut capias… verum nomen eius!”

source: "His true name is…”
target: "Verum nomen eius est…"

source: Suddenly, Father Montserrat’s voice vanished, but his mouth continued opening and closing.
target: Subito vox Patris Montserrat evanuit, sed os eius aperiendum atque claudendum perseverabat.

source: The illusory, hollow cry of a baby echoed in Lumian’s ears once more.
target: Clamor infantis illusori atque vacui iterum in auribus Lumiani resonavit.

source: Unlike before, the cries were distant, as if in another world.
target: Contra priorem, clamores remoti erant, quasi in alio mundo.

source: Lumian’s body didn’t stiffen or turn cold, rendering him immobile.
target: Corpus Lumiani nec riguit nec frigidum factum est, atque ita immobilis mansit.

source: Is the invisible Child of God still wary of the Blood Emperor’s aura?
target: Num invisibilis Puer Dei adhuc aurem Imperatoris Sanguinis timet?

source: Is this instinctive fear?
target: Estne hic metus instinctivus?

source: Lumian quickly surveyed the surroundings and realized that the crimson moonlight on the deck, or rather, around him, had vanished.
target: Lumian celeriter circumspiciens animadvertitque lunarem lucem rubrum in tabulato, vel potius circa se, evanuisse.

source: The area became abnormally dark, preventing even the sound of seawater splashing.
target: Regio facta est insolenter obscura, ne sonus etiam aquae maris stillantis pervenire possit.

source: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”
target: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”

source: The baby’s cries persisted, growing louder and clearer.
target: Clamores infantis perseverabant, augebantur et clariores fiebant.

source: Lumian abruptly lowered his head, fixing his gaze on the breathless Father Montserrat and the stomach of the corpse before him.
target: Lumian subito caput inclinavit et oculos fovens ad Patrem Montserrat anhelantem atque ad ventrem cadaveris ante se positos intenxit.

source: At some indeterminate moment, the stomach bulged, as if something writhed within.
target: Ad aliquum temporis incertum, venter protrudebat, quasi aliquid intus se movebat.

source: Despite the already gaping wounds, a demonic blood‐red glow emanated from the belly.
target: Licet vulnera jam ingentia patefacta essent, ex ventre lumen daemonium rubro sanguine fulgens emanavit.

source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed slightly as he knelt on one knee.
target: Oculi Lumiani paulum constricti sunt, dum in uno genu se inclinavit.

source: Extending his right hand, which grasped the Symphony of Hatred, towards Father Montserrat’s distended stomach.
target: Dextro manu extendens, qua Symphonia Odii teneatur, versus ventrem dilatatum Patris Montserrat contendit.

source: Slash!
target: Incide!

source: A gentle stroke of the black bone flute cleaved open the blood‐red stomach, revealing blood‐stained intestines and internal organs.
target: Subtilis ictus flauti ex ossibus nigris ventrem rubrum sanguineum dividit, revelans intestina sanguine tincta et organa interna.

source: There was no sign of the so‐called Child of God or a moist, filthy baby.
target: Nullum signum Pueri Dei dicti aut infanti humidum atque immundum apparuit.

source: Poof! A substantial amount of transparent, pale‐yellow liquid spewed out from the ruptured blood‐colored stomach, splattering the surrounding deck.
target: Poof! Magna copia liquidi pellucidi, pallidum flavī ex ventre sanguineo rupto erupebat, tabulatum circumiectum spargens.

source: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”
target: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”

source: The baby’s cries intensified, piercing and shrill, drawing closer to Lumian.
target: Clamores infantis augebantur, acuti et stridentes, propius ad Lumian accedentes.

source: He seemed to be gradually overcoming His fear of the Blood Emperor’s aura out of anger and hatred.
target: Videbatur ex ira et odio metum aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis paulatim superare.

source: I need to find a professional to banish this invisible Child of God… Lumian, whose current spirituality allowed him two uses of Spirit World Traversal, planned on seeking assistance.
target: Mihi in peritum inveniendum opus est ad exspellandum hunc invisibilem Puerum Dei… Lumian, cuius praesentis spiritualitatis facultas ei duas usus Transitus Mundi Spiritus concedebat, auxilium petere destinavit.

source: Hunters weren’t experts in such matters!
target: Venatores talibus rebus periti non erant!

source: Yet, after activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian realized he couldn’t sense the spirit world or the coordinates he had once held.
target: Attamen, postquam nigrum signum in dextro umero activatum habuit, Lumian animadvertit se nec spirituum mundum nec notiones coordinarum, quas olim habebat, sentire posse.

source: The abnormal darkness induced by the Child of God’s cries appeared to seal off this area.
target: Obscuritas anomala, aclamore Pueri Dei posita, hanc aream sigillare videbatur.

source: This was closer to Paramita!
target: Hoc propius Paramitae erat!

source: I can’t find help, summon a messenger, or pray to high‐level existences… Lumian’s eyes narrowed as his heart sank.
target: Non possum auxilium invenire, nuntium vocare, aut ad altos existentias precari… Oculi Lumiani contracti sunt, dum cor eius deiectum erat.

source: At that moment, the invisible Child of God’s cries drew nearer, causing Lumian’s body to stiffen and turn cold once again.
target: In illo momento, clamores invisibiles Puer Dei propius accedebant, quod faciebat corpus Lumiani iterum rigidari atque frigidari.

source: As panic surged, Lumian, a Conspirer, swiftly devised a new plan: Exorcism Spell!
target: Dum panica intulerat, Lumian, qui erat Conspirator, celeriter novum consilium excogitavit: Incantatio exorcismatis!

source: One of the five ritualistic magics from Alms Monk, capable of dispelling wraiths and evil spirits.
target: Una ex quinque magiis ritualibus a Monacho Eleemosynario, quae phantasmata ac malos spiritus expellere valeat.

source: The unborn Child of God, invisible in the real world, bore a resemblance to wraiths or evil spirits.
target: Puer Dei nondum natus, invisibilis in mundo reali, similitudinem habebat ad phantasmata aut malos spiritus.

source: Lumian, untroubled by the need for a specific target in his Exorcism Spell, could firstly use his name.
target: Lumian, non vexatus necessitate specifici obiecti in Incantatione Exorcismatis, primo nomine suo uti poterat.

source: Secondly, he could pray to Mr. Fool.
target: Secundo, ad Dominum Foll orare poterat.

source: The proximity‐based response of the seal on his chest, due to the severed connection with the outside world, would provide the necessary level and strength!
target: Responsio sigilli in pectore eius, fundata in propinquitate et ob nexus cum mundo externo iam disiunctos, gradum atque robur necessarium praebebat!

source: An Ascetic, Lumian could simplify parts of the Exorcism Spell for a quick completion.
target: Ut asceticus, Lumian quaedam partem incantationis exorcismatis ad celerem perficiendum simplicare poterat.

source: The hitch was the requirement for the target’s real name and an item frequently carried.
target: Difficultas constat in necessitate veri nominis obiecti ac rei solitum portae.

source: Lumian lacked both.
target: Lumian utrumque caruit.

source: His gaze shifted to Father Montserrat’s open and deflated stomach, searching for something relevant.
target: Animadvertit in ventrem apertum et depressum Patris Montserrat, aliquid pertinente quaerens.

source: If unsuccessful in a minute, he planned to unleash Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s aura, attempting to scare away the invisible Child of God and break through the abnormal darkness for an indirect banishment.
target: Si intra unum minutum non eveniret, proposuit aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor evadere, conatus invisibilem Puerum Dei terrere atque obscuritatem anormalem rumpere ad exspellationem indirectam.

source: After scanning the area a few times, Lumian’s gaze fixed on the chaotic, blood‐stained intestines.
target: Postquam regionem aliquoties perspexit, oculus Lumiani in intestina caotica sanguine maculata fixus est.

source: Amidst them lay a short, flesh‐colored, bloodstained strip, clearly not fully developed.
target: Inter ea iacebat stria brevis, colore carne similis, sanguine maculata, manifeste non plene evoluta.

source: Wh… An incomplete umbilical cord of the Child of God?
target: Quid… Funiculus umbilicalis incompletus Pueri Dei?

source: If it’s truly an umbilical cord, it’s closely tied to the Child of God.
target: Si vere funiculus umbilicalis existit, intime Pueri Dei iungitur.

source: Connected to His flesh and blood.
target: Ad carnem et sanguinem eius adnexus.

source: I don’t even need to know His true name to succeed in the Exorcism Spell…
target: Nec verum nomen eius scire mihi opus est ad incantationem exorcismatis efficaciter peragenda.

source: Lumian retracted the Symphony of Hatred and tore off the suspected incomplete umbilical cord.
target: Lumian Symphoniam Odii retractavit et funiculum umbilicalem incompletum, qui suspectus erat, abripuit.

source: The illusory baby’s cries intensified.
target: Clamores infantis illusori intensiores fierunt.

source: Lumian shuddered and chuckled.
target: Lumian tremuit et subridens iocose respondit.

source: “Thank you for confirming it for me.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago quod id mihi confirmavisti.”

source: He held the incomplete umbilical cord and danced a rhythmic, distorted, primitive dance.
target: Funiculum umbilicale incompletum tenens, saltationem rhythmicam, distortam et primitivam egit.

source: As Lumian danced, he constantly bent down, using the umbilical cord to draw corresponding symbols on the deck with Father Montserrat’s blood.
target: Dum Lumian saltabat, constanter se inclinabat, utens funiculo umbilicali ad sigilla correspondens in tabulato cum sanguine Patris Montserrat delineanda.

source: He simplified the patterns he needed to complete, straightened his body, and pressed his left palm, creating a crimson, nearly white flame on the symbol.
target: Schemata quae perficienda erant simplicavit, corpus suum rectificavit, et palam sinistram premens in signo flammam rubro sanguinolentam, paene albinam, creavit.

source: Then, he placed the umbilical cord into the flames.
target: Tum funiculum umbilicale in flammas posuit.

source: There was a strong symbolic meaning behind this, representing expulsion, incineration, and purification!
target: Hic significatio valde symbolica erat, quae expulsionem, incinerationem, et purificationem repraesentabat!

source: “Waaa!”
target: “Waaa!”

source: The baby’s cries heightened, sending a shiver down Lumian’s spine, causing his body to tremble slightly.
target: Clamores infantis augebantur, et tremor per spinem Lumiani descendebat, faciens corpus eius paulum tremere.

source: Swiftly, he positioned a lit candle atop the flame and umbilical cord.
target: Celeriter, candelam accensam super flammam et funiculum umbilicale imposuit.

source: Stepping back, he recited in Hermes, “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…”
target: Retrocedens, in lingua Hermetica recitavit: “Stultus, qui huic aetati non competit, imperator mysticus supra nebulam cineream; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam imperat…”

source: As the honorific name of Mr. Fool echoed, a wispy gray fog enveloped the surroundings.
target: Dum nomen honorificum Domini Foll resonabat, nebula tenuis cinerea circumiectam involuta est.

source: The unseen baby’s cries diminished, echoing in a haunting hollowness.
target: Clamores infantis invisibiles minuebantur, resonantes in spatio terribili vacuo.

source: Feeling a burning sensation in his left chest, Lumian advanced two steps with a determined expression.
target: Sentiens ardorem in pecto sinistro, Lumian duos passus cum vultu determinato progressus est.

source: He grasped the smoldering umbilical cord, flicked it thrice, and returned it to its place.
target: Funiculum umbilicale fumidum arripuit, ter concussit, et ad locum suum rediit.

source: He continued, “I beseech your assistance. I implore you to banish the object connected to this umbilical cord…”
target: Continuavit: “Auxilium tuum obsecro. Te imploro, expelle rem quae huic funiculo umbilicali adnexa est…”

source: In an instant, the crimson, nearly white, flames tainted the gray fog, burning more intensely.
target: In momento, flammae rubrae, paene albae, nebulam cineream infestarunt, ardentius comburentes.

source: The umbilical cord swiftly charred, revealing Father Montserrat’s transparent face marked by explosions and blood.
target: Funiculum umbilicale celeriter ustum est, revelans faciem transparentem Patris Montserrat, explosionibus et sanguine insignitam.

source: The hollow baby’s cries faded into the distance.
target: Clamores infantis inani in longinquum evanuerunt.

source: Father Montserrat’s spirit involuntarily retreated, relief evident on his pained face.
target: Spiritus Patris Montserrat inviti retrocessit, solatium in vultu dolore eius manifeste ostendens.

source: He was also connected to the umbilical cord, and he was now a ghost!
target: Ipse quoque cum funiculo umbilicali conexus erat, et nunc umbra factus est!

source: With difficulty, Father Montserrat raised his hands and shouted, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace!”
target: Cum difficultate, Pater Montserrat manus extulit et clamavit: “Pretium vitae amplexus, gratia messis!”

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: His transparent Spirit Body rapidly dissipated into the darkness.
target: Corpus spirituale transparentis eius celeriter in tenebras dissolutum est.

source: The invisible Child of God emitted a shrill cry filled with hatred and curses.
target: Puer Dei invisibilis clamor stridulus, plenus odio et maledictis, edidit.

source: The cry echoed in Lumian’s head, making him feel as if he had endured Psychic Piercings repeatedly.
target: Clamor in capite Lumiani resonavit, faciens eum quasi pluries ictus psychicos passi esse.

source: He became extremely weak, his thoughts consumed by the pain in his soul, losing perception of the outside world.
target: Valde debilis factus est, cogitationes eius dolore animi consumpta, ac perceptionem mundi externi amittens.

source: Upon recovery, the abnormal darkness on the deck had vanished, and the crimson moonlight returned.
target: Post recuperationem, obscuritas anomala in tabulato evanuerat, et luna rubra redivit.

source: The symbols on the ground and the gray fog‐colored flames disappeared, leaving only the quietly burning candle and the charred umbilical cord.
target: Symbola in terra et flammae cinereae nebulosae evanuerunt, relinquentes solum candelam tranquille ardentem et funiculum umbilicale comburitum.

source: After a brief pause, Lumian bent down to extinguish the candle flame.
target: Post brevem intervallum, Lumian se inclinavit ad candelam extinguendam.

source: Pressing his hand to his chest, he whispered, “Thank you, Mr. Fool.”
target: Presseens manum in pectus, susurravit: “Gratias tibi ago, Domine Foll!”

source: After stowing away the remnants of the umbilical cord and the ritual candle, Lumian cast a glance at Father Montserrat’s still uncharacteristic corpse.
target: Postquam reliquias funiculi umbilicalis et candelam ritualem recondidit, Lumian aspectum in cadavero adhuc insolito Patris Montserrat intulit.

source: He unleashed his Compression power.
target: Potentiam Compressionis suam exsolvit.

source: His spirituality restored, weakness eased, Lumian finally felt confident enough to return to the cargo hold.
target: Spiritualitate restituta et debilitate levata, Lumian denique satis confidens se sensit ad cellam onerariam redire.

source: Silently, he packed the Pride Armor into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Silentiose, armaturam superbiae in sacculum viatoris suum reponit.

source: Completing this task, he changed into tattered clothes and tended to his exposed wounds briefly.
target: Hoc negotio peracto, vestimenta lacerata induit et vulnera sua patefacta breviter curavit.

source: Enduring the pain, he returned to his suite as if nothing had occurred.
target: Dolorem sustinens, rediit ad conclave suum, quasi nihil accideret.

source: Addressing the captain, Pedro, and the others, he declared, “The problem has been resolved. Father Montserrat’s corpse is on the deck. His belongings will be handed over to the Church of Earth Mother. Right, a Blessed.”
target: Ad capitaneum, Pedro et ceteros loquens, declaravit: “Quaestio soluta est. Cadaver Patris Montserrat in tabulato manet. Res eius tradentur Ecclesiae Matris Terrae. Recte, benedictus.”

source: Lumian harbored no intention of claiming the Church of Earth Mother’s items.
target: Lumian nullam intentionem habebat res Ecclesiae Matris Terrae sibi vindicare.

source: Captain Pedro and the others departed in bewilderment to verify the deck situation.
target: Capitaneus Pedro et cetera, stupefacti, discesserunt ut statum tabulati perscruterent.

source: Lugano approached Lumian and whispered,
target: Lugano Lumian appropinquavit et susurravit,

source: “Is Father Montserrat really dead?”
target: “Num Pater Montserrat vere mortuus est?”

source: “You can take a look at his corpse,” Lumian replied with a “smile,” intending to instruct the servant to provide treatment.
target: “Potes spectare cadaver eius,” respondit Lumian subridens, intendens monere servum ad curationem afferendam.

source: Lugano frowned and said, “But I vaguely heard his voice earlier. He seemed to be shouting the name of the so‐called Child of God.”
target: Lugano fronem contraxit et dixit: “Sed vago olim vocem eius audivi. Videbatur nomen Puer Dei, ita dictum, clamare.”

source: Shouting the so‐called Child of God’s name? Back then, Father Montserrat had indeed shouted the Child of God’s true name, but due to special reasons, it hadn’t reached the real world.
target: Clamare nomen Puer Dei dicti? Olim vero, Pater Montserrat verum nomen Puer Dei clamaverat, sed propter causas speciales ad mundum realem non pervenit.

source: Only Beyonders nearby corrupted by the Child of God could hear it?
target: Solum Beyonders prope, corrupti a Puer Dei, illud audire poterant?

source: Lumian pondered and said to Lugano, “That was before Father Montserrat’s death. What name did he call out?”
target: Lumian cogitavit et Lugano dixit: “Id erat ante mortem Patris Montserrat. Quod nomen clamavit?”

source: Lugano heaved a sigh of relief and recalled, “I think it was… I think it was…”
target: Lugano suspiravit levamen et recordatus est: “Puto id fuisse… puto id fuisse…”

source: Finally, he remembered and recited the pronunciation.
target: Denique recordatus est et pronuntiavit dictionem.

source: “Yes, Omebella.”
target: “Ita, Omebella.”
